applicability: Review reads started by successive selections, refreshes or page requests on one mounted surface.
conditions: Every read takes the next sequence number; only the newest may write the read state or the cache.
exclusions: Cancelling the superseded network request; it is ignored, not aborted (O-R1-3).
statement: Rapid selections A→B→C settle on C: an answer superseded by a later selection is neither displayed nor kept, so choosing B again asks for it again.
